# stb_image

This directory contains the unmodified stb_image v2.34 single-header decoder from
[upstream commit 1da9ade1e66195252114f5da497f244704a6c58d](https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/1da9ade1e66195252114f5da497f244704a6c58d/stb_image.h).

The header includes the complete MIT and public-domain license alternatives.
The decoder is compiled into the AssetPipeline tool module.
